_what: The COULD-NOT-TELL seams tools/sairn_seam_check.py reports, recorded so a RISE is visible. Written by hand from `--propose`; this file is never updated by the watch itself, because a detector that re-baselines its own rise can never report one.
_how_to_update: python tools/seam_cannot_tell_watch.py --propose > docs/seam-cannot-tell-baseline.json  -- and say in the commit WHY each added seam is accepted.
_not_a_claim: COULD-NOT-TELL means unreadable by that tool, not unsafe. A rise means a new seam needs a hand-written test; it does not mean a defect landed.
